F15-F16 fade cleanly to transparency. Every frame must be distinct and continuous. No camera pan, camera zoom, camera rotation, or loop reset. Transparent RGBA background. F01 and F16 must be mostly transparent. Visual effect only: no warrior body and no enemy body. Do not render grid guides, frame labels, captions, borders, or padding.
